shortDescription: Manage protection groups replication schedules on Everpure FlashArrays

options.name: all_for
options.description: Specifies the length of time, in seconds, to keep the snapshots on the source array before they are eradicated. Range available 1 - 34560000.

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: blackout_end
options.description: Specifies the time at which to restart replication. Provide a time in 12-hour AM/PM format, eg. 5PM

options.name: blackout_start
options.description: Specifies the time at which to suspend replication. Provide a time in 12-hour AM/PM format, eg. 11AM

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: days
options.description: Specifies the number of days to keep the I(per_day) snapshots beyond the I(all_for) period before they are eradicated Max retention period is 4000 days

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable the schedule being configured.

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the protection group.

options.name: per_day
options.description: Specifies the number of I(per_day) snapshots to keep beyond the I(all_for) period. Maximum number is 1440

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: replicate_at
options.description: Provide a time in 12-hour AM/PM format, eg. 11AM Only valid if I(replicate_frequency) is an exact multiple of 86400, ie 1 day. Set to an empty string "" to clear an existing at value (sends -1 to the API). Automatically cleared when I(replicate_frequency) changes to a non-day multiple.

options.name: replicate_frequency
options.description: Specifies the replication frequency in seconds. Range 900 - 34560000 (FA-405, //M10, //X10 and Cloud Block Store). Range 300 - 34560000 (all other arrays).

options.name: schedule
options.description: Which schedule to change.

options.name: snap_at
options.description: Provide a time in 12-hour AM/PM format, eg. 11AM Only valid if I(snap_frequency) is an exact multiple of 86400, ie 1 day. Set to an empty string "" to clear an existing at value (sends -1 to the API). Automatically cleared when I(snap_frequency) changes to a non-day multiple.

options.name: snap_frequency
options.description: Specifies the snapshot frequency in seconds. Range available 300 - 34560000.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether to set or delete the protection group schedule.

options.name: target_all_for
options.description: Specifies the length of time, in seconds, to keep the replicated snapshots on the targets. Range is 1 - 34560000 seconds.

options.name: target_days
options.description: Specifies the number of days to keep the I(target_per_day) replicated snapshots beyond the I(target_all_for) period before they are eradicated. Max retention period is 4000 days

options.name: target_per_day
options.description: Specifies the number of I(per_day) replicated snapshots to keep beyond the I(target_all_for) period. Maximum number is 1440

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).
